Name: Onesiphorus
Role: Refresher of Paul, not ashamed of his chain
Summary: Onesiphorus often refreshed Paul and was not ashamed of his chain, seeking Paul out diligently at Rome; Paul also greets his household and prays the Lord grant him mercy.
KeyStory: Onesiphorus often refreshed Paul and was not ashamed of his chain, seeking Paul out diligently at Rome; Paul also greets his household and prays the Lord grant him mercy.
LifeLesson: Seeking out a prisoner instead of shrinking from his chain is mercy in action.
